SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. N. S. B. D. 4782
Date February 16, 1940.
Subject Communication dated 30-1-40 from the British Consulate-General
concerning Mr. V.G. Roudakoff.
Made by D.S. Pavloff. Forwarded by D.I. Crawford.

Vassily Grigorievich ROUDAKOFF, Russian, was born on February 27, 1885 in Orenbourg Province, Russia. Former officer of the Orenbourg Cossack Troops he is reported to have graduated from the Academy for Military Supply Corps Officers at St. Petersburg in 1913, following which he visited Germany in order to study the supply service organization of the German army. During the Great War he served in the Russian army . In 1918 he was a member of the Orenbourg Cossack Government and later served in the "White "army in Siberia, being always attached to the Supply Corps. Following the collapse of Admiral Kolchak's government he served in Ataman Semenoff' army at Chita and later made his way to Vladivostok. Upon evacuation of the Maritime Province by the remnants of the "White" army in 1922, he remained in Russia. It is reported that he received employment under the Soviet government at Chita, Transbaikal Province, as a specialist in chemistry and that later he assisted in the preparation of the first "Five Year Plan" of industrial development of Russian Far East.

Some time in 1931 he appeared in Harbin . According to his own statement, he escaped from the U.S.S.R. After about two years residence in Harbin he arrived in Shanghai early in 1933.

Here he was employed as chief chemist and manager with the "Rosa Vegetable Oil Factory", 941/3 Avenue Petain, for a period. This factory was owned by one L.Z. Shriro, Russian Jew, Soviet citizen, with whom Roudakoff had worked

撰写人 D.S. Pavloff。呈送人 D.I. Crawford。

瓦西里·格里戈里耶维奇·鲁达科夫（Vassily Grigorievich ROUDAKOFF），俄国人，1885年2月27日出生于俄罗斯奥伦堡省。据报他曾是奥伦堡哥萨克部队军官，并于1913年毕业于圣彼得堡军需军官学院，随后前往德国研究德军后勤补给组织体系。大战期间，他在俄军服役。1918年，他是奥伦堡哥萨克政府成员，后来在西伯利亚的“白”军中服役，一直隶属于后勤补给部队。在高尔察克海军上将政府垮台后，他在赤塔的谢苗诺夫阿塔曼军队中服役，随后前往海参崴。1922年，“白”军残部撤离滨海边疆区时，他留在了俄罗斯。据报他在外贝加尔省赤塔受雇于苏维埃政府，担任化学专家，并协助制定了俄罗斯远东工业发展的第一个“五年计划”。

1931年的某个时候，他出现在哈尔滨。据他自己称，他是从苏联逃出来的。在哈尔滨居住约两年后，他于1933年初抵达上海。

在此地，他曾受雇于佩坦路（Avenue Petain）941/3号的“罗莎植物油厂”（Rosa Vegetable Oil Factory），担任首席化学师兼经理，为期一段时间。该工厂由俄籍犹太人、苏联公民 L.Z. Shriro 所有，鲁达科夫在哈尔滨期间曾以类似身份与其共事

in a similar capacity while at Harbin. His next employ-
ment in Shanghai was with Lih Teh Oil Mill, 12 Rue du Con-
sulat, as chief chemist. In 1936 he secured a similar po-
sition with Fao Shing Flour Mill and resided at Fengpu
until the occupation of that place by the Japanese in De-
cember, 1937, following which he returned to Shanghai.
In August, 1938, in partnership with a Russian engineer na-
med A.A. Youkoff and another Russian named L.A. Popoff, em-
ployees of Malcolm & Co., Ltd., he established a business
known as the North China Oil Company, 40 Amherst Avenue.
They still conduct this enterprise.
Houdakoff was never connected with Malcolm & Co.
On account of his activities in the U.S.S.R.
in 1922-1931 he was regarded with a considerable suspi-
cion in Cossack circles at Shanghai from the political
viewpoint. However, he did not come to the notice of the
Municipal Police in connection with any political activi-
ties in Shanghai. It is reported that being an very good
expert in chemistry he devotes his time and attention to
his work.
Houdakoff is registered with the Russian Emi-
grants Committee, Moulmein Road, and at present resides
at 1236 Avenue Joffre, together with his wife.
n.a. Pavloff.-
D.S.

在上海的下一份工作是担任领事馆路（Rue du Consulat）12号的立德油厂（Lih Teh Oil Mill）的首席化学师。1936年，他在丰浦（Fengpu）的茂兴面粉厂（Fao Shing Flour Mill）获得了类似的职位，并居住在该地，直到1937年12月该地被日军占领，随后他返回上海。1938年8月，他与一名名为 A.A. Youkoff 的俄国工程师以及另一名名为 L.A. Popoff 的俄国人合伙创办了一家名为“华北油业公司”（North China Oil Company）的企业，地址为安赫斯特路（Amherst Avenue）40号；这两人均为马尔康有限公司（Malcolm & Co., Ltd.）的雇员。他们目前仍在经营该企业。
胡达科夫（Houdakoff，原文如此，应指鲁达科夫）从未与马尔康有限公司有过关联。
由于他1922年至1931年间在苏联的活动，从政治角度来看，他在上海的哥萨克圈子中受到相当大的怀疑。然而，他并未因在上海的任何政治活动而引起工部局警务处的注意。据报，作为一名非常优秀的化学专家，他将时间和精力都投入到了工作中。
胡达科夫已在穆尔门路（Moulmein Road）的俄国侨民委员会登记，目前与妻子一同居住在霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）1236号。
n.a. Pavloff.-

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY. File No. No. D 4782 Date 17/4/32 Station 2）
Date April 18, 1932
Subject (in full) V. G. Rudakoff, former Soviet Employee.
Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by （签名）
Vasily Grigorievitch Rudakoff, former Soviet employee,
arrived in Shanghai from Harbin about three months ago. He is
a Russian, widower, born in 1885 Ural Province. He is a
former Orenburg Cossack officer and graduated from the
"Intendant Academy." He was sent to Germany to study the
German system of Military supply corps. Rudakoff later served
in the Great War attached to the Supply Corps (Intendanstvo).
During the Revolution in 1918 he was member of Orenburg Cossacks
Government and i/c of supplies to Ataman Dutoff's Army.
Rudakoff held the rank of General and is known to have been
on friendly terms with General Anisimoff, also a Orenburg
Cossack who turned over to the Reds and returned to U.S.S.R. in
1924 from Shanghai (File I.O. 5780). It is reported that
Rudakoff was dismissed by Ataman Dutoff and left for Omsk where
he obtained similar employment. Following the defeat of
Admiral Koltchak's Army he left for Chita where he joined
Atamen Semenoff's Army (Dictator of Transbaikal Province).
During his service with Atamen Semenoff he was suspected by
brother officers of being unloyal to the Whites.
In 1921 Rudakoff resided at Vladivostok and refused
to join the White Army on the ground of his bad health. When
the White Army evacuated the Maritime Province Rudakoff remained
in Russia, and received employment under the Soviet Government.
During the last few years it is reported that he was employed
in the Chita, Transbaikal Province, as a Professor of Chemistry,
and assisted in preparing the "Five-Year Plan" of industrial
development of U.S.S.R. Far East.
Rudakoff claims to have escaped from Soviet Russia
and to have made his way to Harbin.

撰写人 D.S. Tcheremshansky。呈送人 （签名）
瓦西里·格里戈里耶维奇·鲁达科夫，前苏维埃雇员，约三个月前从哈尔滨抵达上海。他是俄国人，鳏夫，1885年出生于乌拉尔省。他是前奥伦堡哥萨克军官，毕业于“军需学院”。他被派往德国研究德国的军事后勤补给体系。鲁达科夫后来在大战期间隶属于后勤补给部队（Intendanstvo）服役。在1918年革命期间，他是奥伦堡哥萨克政府成员，并负责杜托夫阿塔曼军队的物资供应。鲁达科夫拥有将军军衔，据悉他与阿尼西莫夫将军关系友好，后者也是一名奥伦堡哥萨克，投奔红军并于1924年从上海返回苏联（档案 I.O. 5780）。据报，鲁达科夫被杜托夫阿塔曼解职，前往鄂木斯克，在那里获得了类似的工作。在高尔察克海军上将的军队战败后，他前往赤塔，加入了谢苗诺夫阿塔曼的军队（外贝加尔省独裁者）。在为谢苗诺夫阿塔曼服役期间，他被同僚军官怀疑对白人阵营不忠。
1921年，鲁达科夫居住在海参崴，并以健康状况不佳为由拒绝加入白军。当白军撤离滨海边疆区时，鲁达科夫留在了俄罗斯，并受雇于苏维埃政府。据报在过去几年中，他在外贝加尔省赤塔受雇为化学教授，并协助制定了苏联远东工业发展的“五年计划”。
鲁达科夫声称自己是从苏维埃俄罗斯逃脱并前往哈尔滨的。

Upon his arrival in Shanghai he approached the "Russian
Cossacks Union" and proposed to conduct a lecture on the
"Present Situation in U.S.S.R." His request was refused as the
local Orenburg Cossacks do not trust him, and he is regarded
as a man of doubtful reputation, believed to be secretly working
as Soviet agent. Rudakoff then approached one N.P. Malinovsky,
editor of the Russian newspaper "Golos" (Voice), member of
"Krestianskaya Rossia" (Farmers Russia) Party (File D-1647) and
held lecture at his house for a few guests including Mr. Arnoldoff
editor of "Shanghai Zaria."

Rudakoff is employed at present as manager and chemist
at the recently opened "Vegetable Oil Factory Rosa" at 941/3
Avenue Petain in which he holds a number of shares. The
proprietor of this factory is one L.Z. Shriro, Soviet merchant,
Russian Jew who recently arrived from Harbin. Shriro had a
similar factory at Harbin where Rudakoff was formerly employed.

Rudekoff is registered as an emigrant with the Bureau of
Public Safety on February 21, 1932, Registration No.9935.

He resides at 415 Rue Cardinal Mercier.

Rudakoff's description is as follows :-

Height 5' 8"
Brown hair.
Grey-Green eyes.
Ordinary nose.

Photograph of Rudakoff is attached herewith.

抵达上海后，他接触了“俄国哥萨克联盟”，并提出要就“苏联现状”进行演讲。他的请求被拒绝，因为当地的奥伦堡哥萨克人不信任他，认为他名声可疑，被认为是在秘密充当苏联代理人。随后，鲁达科夫接触了 N.P. Malinovsky，此人是俄文报纸《声音报》（Golos）的编辑，“农民俄罗斯”党（Krestianskaya Rossia）成员（档案 D-1647），并在其家中为包括《上海柴拉报》编辑阿诺尔多夫先生在内的少数客人举行了讲座。

鲁达科夫目前受雇于最近在佩坦路（Avenue Petain）941/3号开业的“罗莎植物油厂”（Vegetable Oil Factory Rosa），担任经理兼化学师，并在该厂持有多数股份。该工厂的所有者是 L.Z. Shriro，一位苏联商人、俄籍犹太人，最近刚从哈尔滨抵达。什里罗在哈尔滨有一家类似的工厂，鲁达科夫以前曾在那里工作。

鲁达科夫于1932年2月21日在公共安全局登记为侨民，登记号为9935。

他居住在麦兰神父路（Rue Cardinal Mercier）415号。

鲁达科夫的外貌特征如下：-

身高 5英尺8英寸
棕色头发。
灰绿色眼睛。
普通鼻子。
